about: RUBBLE MVP sound set. Every file is normalised to one loudness family (EBU R128: one-shots and voices to -14 LUFS momentary max, the music to -16 LUFS integrated, sample peak under -1 dBFS); baseVolume is the mix level to apply on top (0..1). Entries with the same group are variants: pick one at random (avoid the last 3 played). Persian voices carry subtitle = the Hebrew bubble text. Groups weapon:<set>:<layer> (shot, mech, reload, empty, charge, loop, release, impact...), impact:<material>, blast:<small|big|thump|debris>; timing and slow-motion data in docs/INTEGRATION_NOTES.md. Made by tools/audio/build_audio.mjs; report docs/reports/SOUND_REPORT.md.
